entries.title: Job 22:1
segments: ¶Then Eliphaz the Temanite answered and said:

entries.title: Job 22:2
segments: "Can a man be profitable to God, Though he who is wise may be profitable to himself?

entries.title: Job 22:3
segments: [Is it] any pleasure to the Almighty that you are righteous? Or [is it] gain [to Him] that you make your ways blameless?

entries.title: Job 22:4
segments: "Is it because of your fear of Him that He corrects you, And enters into judgment with you?

entries.title: Job 22:5
segments: ¶[Is] not your wickedness great, And your iniquity without end?

entries.title: Job 22:6
segments: For you have taken pledges from your brother for no reason, And stripped the naked of their clothing.

entries.title: Job 22:7
segments: You have not given the weary water to drink, And you have withheld bread from the hungry.

entries.title: Job 22:8
segments: But the mighty man possessed the land, And the honorable man dwelt in it.

entries.title: Job 22:9
segments: You have sent widows away empty, And the strength of the fatherless was crushed.

entries.title: Job 22:10
segments: Therefore snares [are] all around you, And sudden fear troubles you,

entries.title: Job 22:11
segments: Or darkness [so that] you cannot see; And an abundance of water covers you.

entries.title: Job 22:12
segments: "Is not God in the height of heaven? And see the highest stars, how lofty they are!

entries.title: Job 22:13
segments: And you say, 'What does God know? Can He judge through the deep darkness?

entries.title: Job 22:14
segments: Thick clouds cover Him, so that He cannot see, And He walks above the circle of heaven.'

entries.title: Job 22:15
segments: ¶Will you keep to the old way Which wicked men have trod,

entries.title: Job 22:16
segments: Who were cut down before their time, Whose foundations were swept away by a flood?

entries.title: Job 22:17
segments: They said to God, 'Depart from us! What can the Almighty do to them?'

entries.title: Job 22:18
segments: Yet He filled their houses with good [things]; But the counsel of the wicked is far from me.

entries.title: Job 22:19
segments: "The righteous see [it] and are glad, And the innocent laugh at them:

entries.title: Job 22:20
segments: 'Surely our adversaries are cut down, And the fire consumes their remnant.'

entries.title: Job 22:21
segments: ¶"Now acquaint yourself with Him, and be at peace; Thereby good will come to you.

entries.title: Job 22:22
segments: Receive, please, instruction from His mouth, And lay up His words in your heart.

entries.title: Job 22:23
segments: If you return to the Almighty, you will be built up; You will remove iniquity far from your tents.

entries.title: Job 22:24
segments: Then you will lay your gold in the dust, And the [gold] of Ophir among the stones of the brooks.

entries.title: Job 22:25
segments: Yes, the Almighty will be your gold And your precious silver;

entries.title: Job 22:26
segments: For then you will have your delight in the Almighty, And lift up your face to God.

entries.title: Job 22:27
segments: You will make your prayer to Him, He will hear you, And you will pay your vows.

entries.title: Job 22:28
segments: You will also declare a thing, And it will be established for you; So light will shine on your ways.

entries.title: Job 22:29
segments: When they cast [you] down, and you say, 'Exaltation [will come]!' Then He will save the humble [person].

entries.title: Job 22:30
segments: He will [even] deliver one who is not innocent; Yes, he will be delivered by the purity of your hands."
